name: Arda Credit Development Environment
description: Development environment for Arda Credit project with Rust, PostgreSQL, and smart contract tooling

install.description: Install all project dependencies including Rust tools, Docker, and development utilities

start.description: Start Docker Desktop daemon required for database and testing operations

setup.description: Set up git hooks for pre-commit linting and pre-push testing

tools.name: make
tools.description: Build system for running development commands

tools.name: cargo
tools.description: Rust package manager and build tool

tools.name: docker
tools.description: Container runtime for database and services

tools.name: kubectl
tools.description: Kubernetes command-line tool for cluster management

tools.name: foundry
tools.description: Ethereum development toolkit for smart contracts

tools.name: kind
tools.description: Kubernetes in Docker for local testing

environment_variables.name: DATABASE_URL
environment_variables.description: PostgreSQL connection string for database operations

environment_variables.name: SINDRI_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: API key for Sindri proof generation service

environment_variables.name: ETHEREUM_RPC_URL
environment_variables.description: Ethereum RPC endpoint for smart contract deployment

environment_variables.name: ETHEREUM_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
environment_variables.description: Private key for Ethereum wallet operations

environment_variables.name: VERIFIER_CONTRACT_ADDRESS
environment_variables.description: SP1 verifier contract address on Ethereum

environment_variables.name: PROGRAM_VKEY
environment_variables.description: Program verification key for contract deployment

pre_commit.description: Run linting checks before committing code changes

pre_push.description: Run test suite before pushing code changes

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Run all linting checks (YAML, GitHub Actions, Docker, Rust)

commands.name: test
commands.description: Run test suite with database setup

commands.description: Initialize database and generate SQLx cache for offline mode

commands.description: Start services with local Docker build
